name: skills
description: Small, focused Claude Code skills: prose linting (slop-cop), second opinions (codex), repo scaffolding (repo-bootstrap), image generation (gen-image), GitHub profile READMEs (gh-profile), Claude-maintained summaries sidecars (repo-summaries), animated CLI demos (cli-demo), and authenticated browser sessions (agent-browser-with-cookies).

plugins.name: slop-cop
plugins.description: Run slop-cop on a file to catch LLM-generated prose tells.

plugins.name: codex
plugins.description: Get a second opinion from OpenAI Codex CLI on hard debugging, analysis, or architecture problems, or generate images with its $imagegen skill.

plugins.name: repo-bootstrap
plugins.description: Bootstrap new projects and repos with base conventions plus opinionated Python, Go, and Swift layers (SPM package/CLI or Xcode app), each with opt-in docs/release features.

plugins.name: llm-prompts
plugins.description: Guidance for writing effective LLM prompts and agent instructions, with current per-provider model notes.

plugins.name: writing-docs
plugins.description: Apply Diataxis modes, a technical-builder voice, the canonical README skeleton (one live install path, install-to-quickstart coherence, no internals), and a slop-cop prose-lint pass when writing project documentation, READMEs, tutorials, how-tos, or reference.

plugins.name: gen-image
plugins.description: Generate project images — mascot logos, README banners (dark/light), social cards, illustrations — via the OpenAI Images API with local under-1MiB compression.

plugins.name: gh-profile
plugins.description: Create or refresh a fancy GitHub profile README from your real repos and activity — AI banner, snake animation, cron Actions, and a daily Claude refresh that summarizes recent commits and releases.

plugins.name: repo-summaries
plugins.description: Maintain a Claude-written summaries sidecar in any repo — a committed read-side module plus a config-driven daily refresh skill that summarizes real commit and release data into one-line suffixes.

plugins.name: cli-demo
plugins.description: Generate animated SVG terminal demos of a CLI with evp — write a .tape, render it (native on Linux x86_64, Docker elsewhere), inspect keyframes, and refine in a loop.

plugins.name: agent-browser-with-cookies
plugins.description: Run authenticated agent-browser sessions by reusing your local browser login — cookies for one or more hosts behind one Touch ID tap (cookiesync CLI), through one ab entry point: Browserbase cloud when its key resolves, local stealth browser otherwise. macOS.

plugins.name: show
plugins.description: Choose the right surface before delivering to the human — prose, AskUserQuestion, a static Artifact page, or a live cc-present board.

plugins.name: design-doc
plugins.description: Run an assumptions-first architecture design — stable-ID registers, decision-by-question rounds, adversarial review, spikes — and ship it as an interactive HTML doc that opens on a summary deck that runs as one argument, draws its system card with Mermaid under a pan-and-zoom that survives the deck, cites entries by readable handles in parentheses, opens every numbers table on its claim, previews every cited source line from GitHub on hover, twins every entry with plain English, hosts declared interactive components and self-laying-out compare figures, links every decision and open item to the pull requests that land it with live GitHub state, replays the interview, and answers questions from the whole document with grounded follow-ups in a collapsed Ask bar and an inline Cmd-K palette behind a deployed key, plus a PDF printed from the same page, written as a humble proposal.

plugins.name: incident-retro
plugins.description: Write incident retrospectives as an interactive HTML page rendered from one canonical retro.json: outage windows and time-to-detect/mitigate/resolve tiles derived from timestamps, a swimlane timeline with Slack quotes, root and contributing causes with evidence, action items with live GitHub state, committed Datadog notebook and monitor snapshots drawn in the page, reader comments, and an in-page assistant; imports Google Docs postmortems.

plugins.name: long-running
plugins.description: Context discipline for orchestrating multi-lane work past one context window — ground truth arrives only as a lane's verdict, anything with a body is a lane, every wait folds into the lane that acts, no lane parks and no lane is re-briefed, and state lives in cc-notes and the task list; ships the lane brief, scoped resume, sequencer lane, polling loop, and handoff plan as templates, plus an open-PR ledger CLI that grades, routes, and holds every open PR over cc-notes.

plugins.name: live-dashboard
plugins.description: A live dashboard assembled per task from typed components: PRs waiting for review, stack landing previews, Slack test-thread feeds, latency percentiles, design gates, Datadog monitors, cci lanes, and local components written for the job at hand, served on a stable port with a scheduler that caches, backs off, and drops secret-shaped payloads.

plugins.name: open-pr
plugins.description: Open a PR in the repo's own voice — guidelines and template from ccx, house style scouted from recent human-authored merged PRs, an OSS politeness and standards pass, shipped via ccx vcs ship, and a background watcher that clears mechanical CI and bot failures.
